task.title: Trading Room aggregate + governed intent handoff (v1.3)

acceptance: trading_room_aggregate/trading_decision_event/governed_intent_handoff schema 落 v4 且對齊 04;Agora 不下單;confidence/probability 分離;handoff 僅 request + no-order-route proof;【驗收】frozen v1/v1.1/v1.2 + 其 bundle_index sha256 全不變;新增物逐欄對齊 design-closure-round2;遇疑問先 blocker 不自行實作
